        w = hi[i] - lo[i]
        if w > 0:

            v = lo[i] + (2.0 * w - r if r > w else r)
        if types[i] == 'integer':
            f = math.floor(v)
            v = float(f + (1 if rng.random() < v - f else 0))
        v = min(max(v, lo[i]), hi[i])
        y[i] = v

        if b - a >= 2:
            i, j = sorted(rng.sample(range(a, b), 2))
            y[i:j + 1] = y[i:j + 1][::-1]
    return y
